figures.name: Tengri

ability.name: Eternal Blue Sky
ability.description: All sky and air abilities gain +3 power; deal 5 damage to all earth-bound dark enemies.

figures.description: The Eternal Blue Sky (Mongke Tengri) who is the supreme deity of all steppe peoples.

figures.name: Etugen

ability.name: Steppe Blessing
ability.description: All nature and earth allies gain +4 to all stats from the great mother earth.

figures.description: The Mongol earth mother goddess who nurtures all life on the endless steppe.

figures.name: Genghis Khan (Chinggis)

ability.name: Sky's Command
ability.description: All Mongolian warrior allies gain +4 power; this card cannot be trapped or immobilized.

figures.description: The world conqueror sent by Tengri whose blue wolf ancestry and divine mandate changed history.

figures.name: Erlik Khan

ability.name: Erlik's Claim
ability.description: Drain 3 HP from all enemies and add 1 HP to this card for each drained.

figures.description: The Mongolian lord of the underworld who rules the dead and sends disease to the living.

figures.name: White Old Man

ability.name: Long Life Gift
ability.description: Grant one ally immunity to all stat reduction for 3 turns.

figures.description: The White Old Man deity of longevity who travels with his deer and blesses the faithful with long life.

figures.name: Blue Wolf Ancestor

ability.name: Wolf Pack
ability.description: All wolf and animal allies gain +3 power; grant +1 speed to all warrior allies.

figures.description: The legendary blue wolf ancestor of the Borjigid clan from which Genghis Khan descended.

figures.name: Umai

ability.name: Soul Guardian
ability.description: All children and newly summoned allies gain +3 defense from Umai's protection.

figures.description: The goddess who protects the souls of children and is associated with the sacred fire of the yurt.

figures.name: Namsara Khan

ability.name: Sky Fire
ability.description: Deal 4 lightning damage to evil enemies; purify one ally of dark effects.

figures.description: The lightning deity who punishes wrongdoers from the sky and brings divine fire to the shaman's ceremony.

figures.name: Noko Zaarin

ability.name: Spirit Master
ability.description: Grant one ally access to the spirit world: look at all enemy abilities for 1 turn.

figures.description: The spirit master who guides and protects the shaman during their dangerous journeys between worlds.

figures.name: Shaman Boo

ability.name: Drum Journey
ability.description: Travel to the spirit world: steal one ability from any card and bring it back for your allies.

figures.description: The male Mongolian shaman who uses drum rhythm to journey to Tengri's realm and negotiate with spirits.

figures.name: Horse Spirit

ability.name: Wind Runner
ability.description: Grant +4 speed to all steppe and warrior allies for 2 turns.

figures.description: The sacred horse spirit of the Mongolian steppe whose speed surpasses all earthly creatures.

figures.name: Nine Levels Heaven

ability.name: Ninth Heaven
ability.description: This card can target any position on the field; it exists at all levels simultaneously.

figures.description: The nine levels of heaven above the steppe where Tengri and divine beings dwell in ascending glory.

figures.name: Altan Gadas

ability.name: Pole Star
ability.description: All ally positions are locked: enemy positioning abilities cannot work for 1 turn.

figures.description: The Golden Nail — the Pole Star — that pins the sky in place and around which all heavens revolve.

figures.name: Three Terrible Ones

ability.name: Triple Terror
ability.description: Deal 2 damage to all enemies three times simultaneously.

figures.description: The three terrible guardian spirits who protect shamans on their spirit journeys.

figures.name: Zaarin Spirit

ability.name: Aerial Shield
ability.description: Block one ranged or sky attack against any ally.

figures.description: The Zaarin sky lords who govern the aerial realms and protect Mongolian warriors in battle.

figures.name: Onon River Spirit

ability.name: Sacred Waters
ability.description: All water allies gain +2 power; grant one warrior ally +2 attack from river blessing.

figures.description: The spirit of the Onon River where Genghis Khan was born and where his sacred origins were rooted.

figures.name: White Shaman

ability.name: Upper World Journey
ability.description: Retrieve a blessing from Tengri: grant +2 to all stats to any one ally.

figures.description: The white shaman who specializes in journeys to the upper worlds of Tengri seeking blessings.

figures.name: Black Shaman

ability.name: Lower World Journey
ability.description: Confront Erlik: steal back one ability that was taken from any ally this battle.

figures.description: The black shaman who dares journey to Erlik's underworld realm to retrieve lost souls.

figures.name: Steppe Wolf

ability.name: Pack Hunt
ability.description: Deal 3 damage to one enemy and 2 to an adjacent enemy simultaneously.

figures.description: The sacred wolf of the Mongolian steppe — ancestor spirit and totem of the Mongol people.

figures.name: Ongon Spirit

ability.name: Ancestral Bond
ability.description: Grant one ally +2 to their two lowest stats from ancestral connection.

figures.description: The felt ancestor spirit tokens kept in Mongolian yurts that house family and clan protective spirits.
